messages.Energie-DP liefert Wh → in kWh umrechnen: Energy data point provides Wh → convert to kWh
messages.Aktivieren, wenn der kumulierte Ladeener: Enable this when the cumulative charging-energy data point provides Wh. NexoWatt divides the value by 1000 and processes it internally as kWh.

text.Ladebedarf / Ladebereit (lesen, optional: Charge demand / ready to charge (read-only, optional)
text.Legacy: Fahrzeug/Ladevorgang aktiv (nur: Legacy: vehicle/charging session active (read-only, not a reservation source)
text.Mehrere Werte mit Komma, Semikolon oder: Separate multiple values with commas, semicolons or line breaks. *Text* allows substring matches.
text.Priorität: reale Leistung → expliziter L: Priority: actual power → explicit charge demand → vehicle connection → normalised status. “Available” alone does not reserve charging power.
text.Fahrzeug/Ladevorgang aktiv (lesen, optio: Vehicle/charging session active (read-only, optional) · legacy, not a reservation source
text.NVP-Zielmitte/Messtoleranz: wird aus der: Grid-point target/tolerance: inherited from the active Storage or Storage Farm app
text.MultiUse besitzt keine eigene NVP-Regelu: MultiUse has no separate grid-point controller. Target and measurement tolerance are always inherited directly from the active Storage or Storage Farm app.
text.Eigene Zielmitte und Messtoleranz der Fa: Dedicated target and measurement tolerance for the storage farm. Outside the tolerance, the shared fast farm controller regulates directly to the target. MultiUse has no second grid-point controller.
